acceptance: The check-run query reads `.check_runs[]`; a test feeds the real API envelope through the runner and a failed oracle-review check run is rerun.
A PR whose auto-merge was on before recovery still has it on afterwards with the same merge method, or recovery skips close-and-reopen and says why.
On a real PR with a failed oracle-review check run, `make oracle-review-recover` reruns it and reports a nonzero count.
context:
Fixed in PR #3313, squash-merged 2026-10-22T23:28:14Z as 3aaf05ddb07ffc57abc8409477df73b4d8ef008e.
- The check-run query filter is now `.check_runs[] | {name, head_sha, status, conclusion, details_url}`.
- A PR with auto-merge armed is not closed and reopened. Recovery reruns the failed runs, then prints that it skipped close-and-reopen because closing turns auto-merge off, and that auto-merge is still armed.

description:
`scripts/oracle_review_recover.py:108` runs `gh api --paginate --jq '{name, head_sha, status, conclusion, details_url}'` on `repos/<repo>/commits/<sha>/check-runs?check_name=oracle-review`. The filter applies to the response envelope (`{total_count, check_runs}`), not to `.check_runs[]`, so every row is `{"name": null, ...}`. `_failed_run_ids` skips rows whose name is not `oracle-review`, so recovery never finds a failed run, always prints `Reran 0 unsuccessful oracle-review run(s)`, then closes and reopens the PR. Closing and reopening turns off auto-merge. The oracle-review failure message points authors at this target, so the documented recovery leaves the stale failures in place and disarms the PR.

The unit test fake (`tests/unit/scripts/test_oracle_review_recover.py:104`) returns pre-flattened check rows, so the tests pass.

Observed 2026-10-22 on PR #3264 (head 68de1e483): failed oracle-review check runs from Actions runs 39706240336 and 39711741625 kept the required `oracle-review` rollup at FAILURE after a later success on the same head. The target reran 0 runs twice; a manual `gh run rerun --failed` of both runs and a second `make pr-arm` were needed. Reproduce: `gh api --paginate --jq '{name}' 'repos/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/commits/<sha>/check-runs?check_name=oracle-review'` prints `{"name":null}`. Related: merge-stale-failure-rollup-blocks.
